nodes.name: cdr.ts
nodes.summary: Cooldown Reduction (CDR) constants for various perks, runes, and weapon arts. Defines reduction percentages and multipliers for caster runes, channeled weapons, mage rage, whirlwind, and more.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure TypeScript constants file, no functions or imports.

nodes.name: damage-types.ts
nodes.summary: Defines all damage types in the game with labels, colors, defense inheritance mappings, and priority ordering. Core type system for the damage engine.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure TypeScript constants with Record and Set types. Derived DMG_TYPE_COLORS from DMG_TYPE_META.

nodes.name: debuff-effects.ts
nodes.summary: Combat effect multipliers for debuffs: Sticky (1.2x damage) and Despair (0.085 coefficient for damage calculation).
nodes.languageNotes: Pure TypeScript constants, no imports.

nodes.name: defensive.ts
nodes.summary: Defensive perk damage reduction values per stack for barbskin, stoneskin, adaptive plate, protector spirit, valor shield, vampire, frenzy, carapace, and other defensive perks.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure TypeScript constants, no imports. Includes computed fractional values (e.g., 10/3 for vampire).

nodes.name: dot-damage.ts
nodes.summary: Damage over Time (DoT) constants: base damage, infliction divisor, potency power cap, rounding factor, and builder-to-game conversion rate.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure TypeScript constants, no imports.

nodes.name: draconic-colors.ts
nodes.summary: Draconic color multiplier effects for fire, air, earth, water, and hex. Defines speed, damage, stun, knockback, and cooldown multipliers per draconic color.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure TypeScript constants, no imports.

nodes.name: draconic.ts
nodes.summary: Draconic infusion potency/duration multipliers, dragon state HP and multiplier values, and bastion blessing multiplier.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure TypeScript constants, no imports.

nodes.name: game.ts
nodes.summary: Core game constants: max/default level, HP defaults, timing constants (debounce, undo window, search blur delay), and calcBaseMaxHP function for computing base HP from level.
nodes.languageNotes: Contains one exported function calcBaseMaxHP. Private constants BASE_HP and HP_PER_LEVEL.

nodes.name: calcBaseMaxHP
nodes.summary: Calculates base maximum HP from player level using formula: round(120 * (1 + level * 0.0125)).
nodes.languageNotes: Simple linear scaling function.

nodes.name: heals.ts
nodes.summary: Healing constants: crit healing base value, holy boost divisor, per-stack healing, and Ocean Song per-stack heal bonus.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure TypeScript constants, no imports.

nodes.name: index.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-export file for all constants modules. Aggregates and re-exports damage-types, game, storage, thresholds, perks, boosts, heals, draconic, perk-base-damage, rune-base-damage, buffs, stat-conversions, defensive, dot-damage, draconic-colors, cdr, debuff-effects, and wa-display.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses wildcard re-exports from all sibling constant modules.

nodes.name: perk-base-damage.ts
nodes.summary: Comprehensive base damage values for all perks in the game (257 lines). Covers Dragon Claw, Dragon Bubble, Springblast, spirits (Basic, Buni, Mageling, Toadzerker, Dire Buni, Void Root, Roguent, Caci, Woof, Winter Woof, Snoeman), Air Pressure, Barbed Flurry, Honey Arts, Whirlwind, Volatile Shell, Pyre Bloom, Bastion Ballista, Runic Blades, Ice Burst, Ichor Spark, Deathmist Slash, and many more.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure TypeScript constants file with 250+ exported numeric constants organized by perk name.

nodes.name: perks.ts
nodes.summary: Perk gameplay constants: crit base values, crit-rate multipliers (Flowing Crits, Spell Slinger, Sharp Crits, Seismic Momentum, Perfection), crit-damage formulas (Thief Training, Venom Eater, Vital Strikes, Spark, Critical Master, Splinter), Mortal Will, Sunburn, Frostbite, Cryo Engine, Fiery Pursuit, Hypnotist, Phantom Pain, Pursuit, Darkening Hex, and Kindling.
nodes.languageNotes: Large constants file (114 lines) with grouped sections for different perk categories.

nodes.name: rune-base-damage.ts
nodes.summary: Rune base damage values for active rune abilities: Ancient Cleric, Beenade, Boostshroom, Thunderous Charge, Sporeling Toss, Foot Dive, Caci, Cacitrops, Hex Web, Brainblast, Rocky Tail, and Slayer Rage.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure TypeScript constants organized by rune name.

nodes.name: stat-conversions.ts
nodes.summary: Stat boost conversion rates for perks that convert one stat to another: Weight Distribution, Quick Witted, Whirl Foot, Carapace, Frozen Heart, Immovable, Righted Wrongs, Rocky Body, Spellshield, Strong Tides, Swift Guard, True Balance, Rawny. Also includes stat subtraction constants.
nodes.languageNotes: Pure TypeScript constants with fractional and computed values.

nodes.name: storage.ts
nodes.summary: Local storage key definitions, build state defaults with all equipment slots and toggle fields, save key mapping/unmapping for URL compression, enchantment key mapping, and max build slot count.
nodes.languageNotes: Imports DEFAULT_LEVEL, DEFAULT_HP_FILL, DEFAULT_ENEMY_HP_FILL from game.ts. Contains large BUILD_STATE_DEFAULTS object and bidirectional key maps.

nodes.name: thresholds.ts
nodes.summary: Gameplay threshold constants: armor penetration branch threshold (0.2), minimum cooldown (1), and base crit damage percentage (100).
nodes.languageNotes: Pure TypeScript constants, no imports.

nodes.name: wa-display.ts
nodes.summary: Weapon Art display name resolution. Maps perk-modified weapon art names to display names (e.g., 'Slam' → 'Weighty Slam' when Weighty Slam perk is active).
nodes.languageNotes: Contains one exported function getWADisplayName with internal WA_PERK_DISPLAY_NAMES lookup table.

nodes.name: getWADisplayName
nodes.summary: Resolves the display name for a weapon art based on active perks. Checks WA_PERK_DISPLAY_NAMES mapping and returns modified name if applicable perk is active.
nodes.languageNotes: Iterates over perk display name entries and checks perk stack counts.

nodes.name: crit.ts
nodes.summary: Critical hit calculation engine (340 lines). Computes natural crit chance from dexterity and elemental boosts, extra crit from Carrying Winds and Caci King Spirit, crit damage multiplier from multiple perk sources, Primal scaling, and proc coefficient interactions. Returns comprehensive CritResult with full breakdowns.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript module with multiple internal source arrays (NATURAL_CRIT_SOURCES, EXTRA_CRIT_SOURCES, CRIT_DMG_SOURCES), helper functions, and one main exported calcCrit function. Uses types from types.ts and utils.ts.

nodes.name: calcCrit
nodes.summary: Main critical hit calculation function. Takes stats, perks, and optional proc coefficient. Computes natural crit chance (with Primal scaling), extra crit sources, combined effective crit chance, and crit damage multiplier. Returns detailed CritResult with breakdowns and formula string.
nodes.languageNotes: 340-line function with multiple phases: natural crit, extra crit, combined chance, proc scaling, and crit damage. Uses reduce for probability combination.

nodes.name: calcDexterity
nodes.summary: Calculates dexterity-based crit contribution from dexterity boost stat divided by DEX_CRIT_DIVISOR.
nodes.languageNotes: Simple division and rounding helper.

nodes.name: calcElementalBoost
nodes.summary: Calculates elemental boost-based crit contribution for a given perk using multiplier * stat * stacks formula.
nodes.languageNotes: Generic helper used by Flowing Crits, Spell Slinger, Sharp Crits, Seismic Momentum.

nodes.name: calcPerfection
nodes.summary: Calculates Perfection perk crit contribution: stacks * PERFECTION_CRIT_PER_STACK.
nodes.languageNotes: Simple multiplication helper.

nodes.name: hasActiveGatingPerks
nodes.summary: Checks if any source in the array has active gating perks (perk stacks > 0).
nodes.languageNotes: Uses some() with optional chaining on gatingPerks array.

nodes.name: damageTypeResolve.ts
nodes.summary: Damage type resolution pipeline (175 lines). Handles merging base types with bonuses, Fire/Air conversion (Echo Incineration), WA damage type key resolution (Same as weapon, Highest damage type, explicit types), effective WA damage type computation with Spirit Winds Air→Magic conversion, Dark Magic hex bonus, and perk-specific overrides (Wild Bolt, Weighty Slam, Heat Drill, Essence Ray).
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript module with 6 exported functions and 1 interface. Imports round4 from engine/_utils and DMG_TYPE_PRIORITY from constants/damage-types.

nodes.name: resolveDamageTypes
nodes.summary: Merges bonus damage types into base types, adding values and rounding to 4 decimal places.
nodes.languageNotes: Simple object merge with rounding.

nodes.name: applyFireAirConversion
nodes.summary: Converts 50% of Fire↔Air damage (Echo Incineration perk effect).
nodes.languageNotes: Bidirectional conversion with rounding.

nodes.name: resolveWaDamageTypeKeys
nodes.summary: Resolves weapon art damage type keys from WA damage type string: 'Same as weapon', 'Highest damage type', or explicit type:percentage strings parsed via regex.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses regex parsing for explicit type strings and priority-based reduction for highest type.

nodes.name: getFinalWaDmgTypes
nodes.summary: Combines resolveWaDamageTypeKeys and resolveDamageTypes to get final WA damage types with bonuses applied.
nodes.languageNotes: Thin composition of two other functions.

nodes.name: computeEffectiveWaDmgTypes
nodes.summary: Single source of truth for effective WA damage types. Handles Wild Bolt, Weighty Slam, Heat Drill, Essence Ray overrides, then general WA type resolution with Air→Magic conversion, Echo Incineration, and Dark Magic hex bonus.
nodes.languageNotes: Large function with multiple conditional branches for different WA override scenarios.

nodes.name: applyAirToMagicConversion
nodes.summary: Converts a fraction of Air damage to Magic (Spirit Winds), then applies Echo Incineration Fire↔Air conversion, then Dark Magic hex bonus on native magic only.
nodes.languageNotes: Multi-step conversion pipeline with careful ordering (Spirit Winds before Echo Incineration).

nodes.name: defense.ts
nodes.summary: Defense calculation module (81 lines). Resolves defense sources into percent and flat multipliers, provides DEF_GROUP mapping from damage types to defense stat keys, and calculates base armor defense percentage.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript module with 3 exported functions, 1 exported constant, and 3 interfaces. Imports roundMultiplier from utils.

nodes.name: calcDefMultiplier
nodes.summary: Converts defense percentage to damage multiplier: 1/(1+def) for positive, 1+abs(def) for negative.
nodes.languageNotes: Private helper with branching logic for positive/negative defense.

nodes.name: calcTrueDrPercent
nodes.summary: Calculates true damage reduction percentage from defense percentage using def/(1+def) formula.
nodes.languageNotes: Private helper with Math.max to handle negative defense.

nodes.name: resolveDefenseSources
nodes.summary: Resolves an array of DefenseSource objects into percent and flat multiplier groups, computing individual and combined multipliers.
nodes.languageNotes: Separates sources into percent and flat groups, then reduces each group multiplicatively.

nodes.name: calcBaseArmorDefPct
nodes.summary: Calculates total base armor defense percentage for a given damage type by summing relevant defense stats from DEF_GROUP mapping.
nodes.languageNotes: Simple sum over DEF_GROUP keys with rounding.

nodes.name: dmgTypes.ts
nodes.summary: Damage type computation interfaces and badge configuration. Defines BADGE_CONFIG for 30+ on-hit effect badges with colors and descriptions, ComputedType for individual damage type breakdown, PerkOnHitDmg for perk on-hit damage specs, and ComputedHit for complete hit computation results.
nodes.languageNotes: TypeScript module with interfaces and a large config object. Imports ProcCoefficient from types.

nodes.name: EnchantSelect.svelte
nodes.summary: Svelte component for enchantment selection dropdown (464 lines). Features searchable dropdown with keyboard navigation, enchantment color coding (50+ enchantments), portal-based positioning, scroll/resize repositioning, and full accessibility (ARIA roles, keyboard support).
nodes.languageNotes: Svelte component with <script>, <template>, and <style> sections. Uses createEventDispatcher, onMount/onDestroy lifecycle, slide transition. Imports FOCUS_DELAY_MS from constants.

nodes.name: enchantTooltip.ts
nodes.summary: Generates formatted tooltip text for enchantments by fetching enchant data from the engine, then formatting description, stats, effects, and additional notes into a newline-separated string.
nodes.languageNotes: Single exported function, imports getEnchant from engine module.

nodes.name: getEnchantTooltipText
nodes.summary: Builds enchantment tooltip text from enchant data: description, stat modifiers, effects, and additional notes.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses flatMap and map for stat formatting. Handles multiplier vs flat stat display.

nodes.name: engine.ts
nodes.summary: Barrel re-export file for the engine module. Aggregates and re-exports from engine/data, engine/shrine, engine/enchant, engine/weapon, engine/build, and engine/format submodules.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses wildcard re-exports from all engine submodules.

nodes.name: _utils.ts
nodes.summary: Rounding utility functions used throughout the engine: round2 (2 decimal places) and round4 (4 decimal places) with epsilon compensation.
nodes.languageNotes: Two exported arrow functions using Number.EPSILON for floating point precision.

nodes.name: round2
nodes.summary: Rounds a number to 2 decimal places with epsilon compensation.
nodes.languageNotes: Arrow function: Math.round((v + Number.EPSILON) * 100) / 100

nodes.name: round4
nodes.summary: Rounds a number to 4 decimal places with epsilon compensation.
nodes.languageNotes: Arrow function: Math.round((v + Number.EPSILON) * 10000) / 10000
